blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Despite assurances of ample food supply, the Department of Agriculture (DA) said the southwest monsoon and a possible strong El Niño may affect local farm production in the second half of 2026. The DA did not provide specific estimates of the projected decline in output. Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. stated that the impact may not be as severe as initially feared because they now expect the peak of the prolonged drought in January instead of November.
